title: Schedule of Project Fees — Line Extensions and New Service Construction
content:
Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative bills three fixed project fees on **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** projects in the fees schedule below: the engineering design fee paid with the application before staking, the change order fee for a design change the member requests after the estimate, and the restaking fee for a new estimate after the first estimate expired. Each fee is billed to the project.

## Fees by class

| Class of extension | Engineering design fee | Design fee credited against the contribution at signing | Change order fee | Restaking fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | $150.00 | Yes | $75.00 | $125.00 |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | $150.00 | Yes | $75.00 | $125.00 |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | $150.00 | Yes | $75.00 | $125.00 |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | $200.00 | Yes | $75.00 | $125.00 |
| Irrigation Well Extension | $300.00 | Yes | $75.00 | $125.00 |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | $450.00 | Yes | $75.00 | $125.00 |
| Temporary Construction Service | $75.00 | No | $75.00 | $125.00 |

## Fee descriptions

- **Engineering design fee** — paid with the application, before the staking engineer stakes the line. It ranges from $75 on the Temporary Construction Service to $450 on the Three-Phase Commercial Extension.
- **Design fee credit at signing** — on six classes the design fee already paid is credited against the contribution when the line extension agreement is signed. On the Temporary Construction Service the column reads No, so no such credit is made.
- **Change order fee** — $75 in every class.
- **Restaking fee** — $125 in every class.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Irrigation Well Extension member pays the $300 engineering design fee with the application. At signing, because that class shows Yes in the credit column, the $300 already paid is credited against the contribution. A hypothetical Temporary Construction Service applicant pays a $75 design fee, and no credit of it is made at signing.
